chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said to a man:

key_terms.اِحْلِقْ: shave; a command to remove the hair
key_terms.رَسُولُ: the Messenger, referring to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about shaving the head and beautification?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a brief prophetic instruction encouraging grooming and beautification. It indicates that shaving is a means of enhancing one's appearance and reflects the importance of cleanliness and proper etiquette.
